analysis: The trial succeeded: host validation macro HR@10 reached 0.6175, improving by 0.0825 over the reported MultVAE reference (0.535) and 0.1125 over SASRec (0.505). Category HR@10 was 0.680 Movies_and_TV, 0.645 Industrial_and_Scientific, 0.450 Electronics, and 0.695 CDs_and_Vinyl. Electronics remains the weakest category. Results support retaining this ensemble, but component metrics and ablations were not supplied, so the specific source of improvement is unverified. The host reported 903.55 allocated GPU-seconds.
code_summary: Trains independent MultVAE and SASRec experts per category. MultVAE uses deduplicated full-history binary inputs, 256 hidden units, 64 latent dimensions, dropout, multinomial reconstruction, and annealed KL. SASRec uses chronological right-aligned sequences, default length 200, hidden size 50, two attention blocks, and sampled BCE training. Each expert selects its checkpoint independently by validation HR@10 with NDCG@10 breaking ties. Inference averages normalized descending candidate ranks with average ranks for ties. Export preserves all four dataset routes and checks reload and predictor agreement.
